title: MarketTrajectory
description: Typed market trajectory descriptor. kind is static or orbital-elements. For orbital-elements, orbit.epoch is the element reference epoch, distinct from spatial.epochMs and request time. The schema does not establish coordinate-basis compatibility. Active station responses use the backend-materialized spatial snapshot at the resolved host's spatial.epochMs; clients must not re-evaluate the station orbit or add the host again. Non-station trajectory evaluation behavior is not a guarantee of this response shape.

epoch.description: UTC element reference epoch, not the returned station spatial snapshot epoch.
